units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:15">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ גרמידי דאַנִּ׳ לבני נ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ד׳ אמות … דבני אנ׳</he>) four cubits on the shores of a dyke belong to the owners of the dyke.
<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:4">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>לא תשוור נ׳</he> leap not over a dyke (oth. opin., v. infra).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 12b:14">B. Bath. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>תרתי אחד נ׳</he> two fields dependent on one dyke for irrigation; a. e.—Pl. <he>נִיגְרֵי</he>, <cite ref="N00620"><he>נִגְ׳</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: track, step. Pes. l. c. לא תשוור נ׳ do not leap in place of walking (v. supra).—Pl. as ab.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 57a:8">B. Kam. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>נקטי להו נ׳ ברייתא</he> Rashi (ed. sing.) they adopted the habit of running out into the fields; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 118b:1">ib. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>אנקטה נ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>אנקטי</he>) he taught her the way out of the fold; <cite ref="Bava Batra 88a:2">B. Bath. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>אנקטינהו ניגרא וכ׳</he> he taught them &c.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 51b:11">Sabb. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ דחמרא שערי</he> the gait of the ass is (in accordance with) the barley (which he feeds on).
<cite ref="Shabbat 66b:9">Ib. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>קל נ׳</he> the sound of steps.
